items.title: Invoice OCR API for Logistics Expense Tracking Automation
items.snippet: Logistics and transportation companies handle large volumes of invoices for fuel, freight, tolls, and vendor services. Manually recording these expenses can slow down financial tracking and increase the chances of data entry errors. An Invoice OCR API helps automate this process by extracting important information directly from invoice images or PDFs. Using OCR technology, the system can capture details such as invoice numbers, vendor names, dates, line items, and total amounts. This structured data allows businesses to monitor logistics expenses more efficiently, simplify reconciliation, and improve overall financial visibility across transportation operations.

items.title: Invoice OCR API for Automated GST Data Extraction in India
items.snippet: Invoice processing and GST data management can be time-consuming when handled manually. An Invoice OCR API helps automate this process by extracting important information directly from invoice images or PDFs. Using AI-powered OCR technology, the system can detect fields such as invoice number, vendor details, invoice date, line items, and total amounts. It can also capture GST-specific data like GSTIN numbers, HSN/SAC codes, taxable values, and tax amounts. Automating invoice data extraction helps businesses reduce manual entry errors, speed up reconciliation, and simplify GST compliance when handling large volumes of invoices. https://azapi.ai/blog/invoice-ocr-api-with-gst-extraction-india/

items.title: FinCrew: Multi-Agent AI Financial Intelligence

FinCrew is an AI CFO platform with multiple specialized agents (Data Ingestion, Transaction Recording, Invoice Management, Fraud Detection, CFO Orchestrator) using multi-agent orchestration with anti-hallucination safeguards. Existing solutions don't serve the mid-market segment. They're either SMB-focused or enterprise-only. We're targeting the $150B+ TAM in between. We're looking for feedback, beta users, and discussing investment. Happy to answer questions in the thread.

items.title: Tell HN: AI coding is sexy, but accounting is the real low-hanging target
items.snippet: Working on automating small business finance (bookkeeping, reconciliation, basic reporting). One thing I keep noticing: compared to programming, accounting often looks like the more automatable problem: It’s rule-based Double entry, charts of accounts, tax rules, materiality thresholds. For most day-to-day transactions you’re not inventing new logic, you’re applying existing rules. It’s verifiable The books either balance or they don’t. Ledgers either reconcile or they don’t. There’s almost always a “ground truth” to compare against (bank feeds, statements, prior periods). It’s boring and repetitive Same vendors, same categories, same patterns every month. items.snippet: Isaac abre dos sucursales de El Dolarón: **Avenida Salk** y **Coronel Romero**. Arrancan de cero (sin equipo, cuentas ni mercancía). Este Issue fija las reglas que pide `docs/ARQUITECTURA-OBJETIVO.md` («Segunda tienda») antes de escribir código, y ordena el trabajo en PRs. ## Operación que se quiere 1. Toda la mercancía se **captura y etiqueta en Soledad**, como hoy. 2. En Soledad se arma un **bulto**: se escanea cada etiqueta, se cierra y se sella con su folio impreso. 3. El bulto viaja. Al llegar, la sucursal **escribe o escanea el folio** y sus piezas entran a la existencia de esa sucursal. 4.
